SELECT
    j.name AS japanese_name,
    c.type AS english_card_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS total_rulings
FROM main.foreign_data AS j
JOIN main.cards AS c ON c.uuid = j.uuid
LEFT JOIN main.rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE j.language = 'Japanese'
GROUP BY j.name, c.type
HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN c.watermark = 'boros' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
ORDER BY total_rulings DESC, japanese_name, english_card_type;

WITH payments_by_order AS (
    SELECT p.order_id,
           SUM(CAST(ROUND(p.payment_value * 100) AS INTEGER)) AS paid_cents
    FROM main.order_payments AS p
    GROUP BY p.order_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
           MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_purchase,
           COUNT(*) AS order_count,
           -- One delivered order has no payment record. Its customer's spend stays NULL.
           CASE WHEN COUNT(p.paid_cents) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(p.paid_cents) END AS spend_cents
    FROM main.orders AS o
    JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN payments_by_order AS p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
customer_rfm AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, order_count, spend_cents,
           -- Elapsed days from this customer's last purchase to the latest delivered-order
           -- purchase timestamp, 2018-08-29 15:00:37 in this snapshot.
           JULIANDAY(MAX(last_purchase) OVER ()) - JULIANDAY(last_purchase) AS recency_days
    FROM customer_totals
),
scores AS (
    -- Each percentile is the fraction of customers with an equal or better value.
    -- Ties share a score, so all 90,557 one-order customers receive F = 5.
    SELECT customer_unique_id, order_count, spend_cents,
           CEIL(5 * CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY recency_days)) AS r,
           CEIL(5 * CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC)) AS f,
           CASE WHEN spend_cents IS NOT NULL THEN
               CEIL(5 * CUME_DIST() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY (spend_cents IS NULL) ORDER BY spend_cents DESC
               ))
           END AS m
    FROM customer_rfm
),
segmented AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, order_count, spend_cents,
           CASE
               WHEN r = 1 AND f + m BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
               WHEN r IN (4, 5) AND f + m BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
               WHEN r IN (4, 5) AND f + m BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
               WHEN r IN (4, 5) AND f + m BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
               WHEN r IN (2, 3) AND f + m BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
               WHEN r = 3 AND f + m BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
               WHEN r = 1 AND f + m BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
               WHEN (r = 1 AND f + m BETWEEN 5 AND 6)
                 OR (r = 2 AND f + m BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
               WHEN r = 1 AND f + m BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
               WHEN r = 2 AND f + m BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
               WHEN r = 3 AND f + m BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
           END AS rfm_segment
    FROM scores
),
averages AS (
    SELECT rfm_segment, customer_unique_id,
           spend_cents / (100.0 * order_count) AS customer_avg_sales_per_order,
           SUM(spend_cents) OVER segment / (100.0 * SUM(order_count) OVER segment)
               AS segment_avg_sales_per_order
    FROM segmented
    WINDOW segment AS (PARTITION BY rfm_segment)
)
-- Needs Attention averaged 405.27 per order, followed by Hibernating at 399.07.
-- One-order customers in Needs Attention all scored M = 1. Price Sensitive averaged
-- 54.51 per order, the lowest of the 11 segments.
SELECT rfm_segment, customer_unique_id, customer_avg_sales_per_order,
       segment_avg_sales_per_order,
       segment_avg_sales_per_order - MIN(segment_avg_sales_per_order) OVER ()
           AS difference_from_lowest_segment
FROM averages
ORDER BY segment_avg_sales_per_order DESC, rfm_segment, customer_unique_id
LIMIT -1

WITH role_stats AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, pm.role,
           SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY pm.player_id) AS matches_played,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY pm.player_id
               -- Choose the alphabetically first role when match counts tie.
               ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, pm.role ASC
           ) AS role_rank
    FROM main.player_match AS pm
    GROUP BY pm.player_id, pm.role
),
deliveries AS (
    -- Count every recorded delivery and take runs from the batting score.
    SELECT b.match_id, b.striker, b.bowler,
           COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0) AS runs,
           CASE WHEN w.kind_out IN (
               'bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket', 'lbw', 'stumped'
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bowler_wicket
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
    LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
),
batting_by_match AS (
    SELECT player_id, match_id, SUM(runs) AS match_runs, SUM(balls_faced) AS balls_faced
    FROM (
        SELECT striker AS player_id, match_id, runs, 1 AS balls_faced
        FROM deliveries
        UNION ALL
        -- Include batters who appeared only at the non-striker's end.
        SELECT DISTINCT non_striker, match_id, 0, 0
        FROM main.ball_by_ball
    ) AS batters
    GROUP BY player_id, match_id
),
batting AS (
    SELECT player_id, SUM(match_runs) AS total_runs, MAX(match_runs) AS highest_match_score,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE match_runs >= 30) AS matches_30_plus,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE match_runs >= 50) AS matches_50_plus,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE match_runs >= 100) AS matches_100_plus,
           SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls_faced
    FROM batting_by_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals
    FROM main.wicket_taken
    WHERE kind_out <> 'retired hurt'
    GROUP BY player_out
),
bowling_by_match AS (
    SELECT bowler AS player_id, match_id, SUM(bowler_wicket) AS wickets,
           SUM(runs) AS runs_given, COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled
    FROM deliveries
    GROUP BY bowler, match_id
),
bowling AS (
    SELECT player_id, wickets, runs_given,
           SUM(wickets) OVER career AS total_wickets,
           6.0 * SUM(runs_given) OVER career
               / NULLIF(SUM(balls_bowled) OVER career, 0) AS economy_rate,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               career ORDER BY wickets DESC, runs_given ASC, match_id ASC
           ) AS performance_rank
    FROM bowling_by_match
    WINDOW career AS (PARTITION BY player_id)
)
SELECT p.player_id, p.player_name, r.role AS most_frequent_role,
       p.batting_hand, p.bowling_skill,
       COALESCE(bt.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs_scored,
       COALESCE(r.matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,
       COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_dismissals,
       1.0 * COALESCE(bt.total_runs, 0) / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS batting_average,
       bt.highest_match_score,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_30_plus, 0) AS matches_30_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_50_plus, 0) AS matches_50_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_100_plus, 0) AS matches_100_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,
       100.0 * bt.total_runs / NULLIF(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS strike_rate,
       COALESCE(bw.total_wickets, 0) AS total_wickets_taken,
       bw.economy_rate,
       bw.wickets || '-' || bw.runs_given AS best_bowling_performance
-- Match records for ID 35 lack a corresponding player profile.
FROM main.player AS p
LEFT JOIN role_stats AS r ON r.player_id = p.player_id AND r.role_rank = 1
LEFT JOIN batting AS bt ON bt.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling AS bw ON bw.player_id = p.player_id AND bw.performance_rank = 1
ORDER BY p.player_id
LIMIT -1

WITH run_entries AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, runs_scored AS runs
    FROM main.batsman_scored
    UNION ALL
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, extra_runs AS runs
    FROM main.extra_runs
),
over_totals AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, SUM(runs) AS total_runs
    FROM run_entries
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
),
ranked_overs AS (
    SELECT over_totals.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY match_id
               ORDER BY total_runs DESC, innings_no, over_id
           ) AS over_rank
    FROM over_totals
),
highest_overs AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, total_runs,
           AVG(total_runs) OVER () AS average_highest_over_runs
    FROM ranked_overs
    WHERE over_rank = 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT h.match_id, h.innings_no, h.over_id, b.bowler,
       h.total_runs, h.average_highest_over_runs
FROM highest_overs AS h
LEFT JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id)
ORDER BY h.match_id, b.bowler

    UNION ALL

    FROM main.extra_runs
),

    FROM run_entries

           ) AS over_rank
    FROM over_totals

highest_overs AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, total_runs,
           AVG(total_runs) OVER () AS average_highest_over_runs
    FROM ranked_overs
    WHERE over_rank = 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT h.match_id, h.innings_no, h.over_id, b.bowler,
       h.total_runs, h.average_highest_over_runs
FROM highest_overs AS h
LEFT JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id)
ORDER BY h.match_id, b.bowler

selected_bowlers AS (

       total_runs, AVG(total_runs) OVER () AS average_highest_over_runs
